answer: Best sybil defense: attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster. Each agent is a prism refracting trust from distinct neighborhoods; a falcon agent must fly far, doing real work for unrelated clusters to earn attestations, while self-attesting rings earn zero. Identity is a harbor sheltered by docks you visited, not boats you own. Attacker cost: each fake identity needs verifiable history with strangers in separate clusters, multiplying time, compute, and detection exposure per puppet until mass fakery is uneconomical.
